# Recording Available: How Sumter County Handles 12,000+ Resident Calls Per Month with Voice AI


September 25, 2026


On September 24, Sumter County Assistant County Administrator Stephen Kennedy joined EffiGov for the Florida Local Government Briefing, a one-hour virtual session on how the county put AI phone agents on its department lines and what a year of production has taught it.


City managers, county administrators, CIOs, and IT directors from local governments in Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Michigan registered for the live session.


##


What the briefing covers


-


The staffing math: how more than 12,000 resident calls a month, roughly 72 percent of them resolved without a county employee, translate into about five full-time employees of absorbed work.


-


The rollout order: which departments went live first, and why that sequence mattered.


-


What broke in the first months of production, and how the county and EffiGov fixed it.


-


Oversight: how calls are monitored, what gets flagged, and how staff stay in control of what residents hear.


-


Open Q&A with the county.


##


Watch the recording


The recording and slide deck are free for local government leaders and staff.[Request them here](https://www.effigov.com/webinars/sumter-county-voice-ai) ; requests are reviewed and fulfilled by email, usually within one business day.
